key_insight: IANN unifies seven equivariant interatomic neural network architectures in one PyTorch framework, making architecture selection a one-word configuration change.
engineering_relevance: A shared training and deployment pipeline reduces re-engineering when comparing ML interatomic potentials or integrating them into atomistic simulations.
method: Standardizes atomic data, training and deployment across PaiNN, NequIP, MACE, Allegro, EquiformerV2, EquiformerV3 and UMA.
Derives forces, stresses and virials analytically from energy via graph edge vectors, including periodic boundary conditions.
Automatically configures distributed training and supports checkpoint deployment through ASE and TorchScript-based LAMMPS interfaces.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports common-dataset training on millions of structures and released PaiNN foundation models trained on 41.9 million curated DFT structures spanning PBE, RPBE and r2SCAN.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative accuracy or runtime benchmarks, so performance trade-offs between architectures remain to be assessed.
paper_title: IANN: A Unified Framework for Equivariant InterAtomic Neural Networks with User-Friendly Implementation
